reviews.text: Without a doubt, this cleansing foam has become my absolute favorite! It’s incredibly gentle on my sensitive skin while leaving it impeccably clean—without that tight, dry feeling other cleansers often leave behind. Plus, the addition of low molecular hyaluronic acid in the formula is a delightful bonus that truly elevates the experience!
reviews.zh: 無疑問，呢款潔面泡沫已經成為我最愛！對我嘅敏感皮膚非常溫和，清潔得極之乾淨，唔會似其他潔面產品咁令皮膚繃緊、乾燥。另外，配方加入咗低分子透明質酸，係一個令人驚喜嘅額外好處，真係提升咗整體體驗！

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Low Molecule Hyaluronic Acid Cleansing Foam 150mL Special Set (+30mL)
reviews.text: My absolute favorite cleanser. Just a small amount goes a long way. Gentle and hydrating and use it as a body wash at least once a week because it makes your skin feel that good. Great for my mature, sensitive, 80’s kid who didn’t believe in sunscreen until they were in their late 40’s skin.
reviews.zh: 我最愛嘅潔面產品。只需要少少份量就夠用。溫和又保濕，我每個禮拜最少用嚟沖涼一次，因為用咗令皮膚感覺好好。啱我呢啲成熟、敏感嘅皮膚，我係 80 後，到咗四十幾歲先開始相信防曬嘅重要性。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Cleansing Foam 150mL
reviews.text: I have oily acne-prone skin and this cleanser was the best one I ever used before! It feels super super soft on my skin and cleanses so well! My skin felt very clean after using it! I would definitely recommend it! I think for dry skin it could dry out a bit too much tho!
reviews.zh: 我係油性易生暗瘡嘅皮膚，呢款潔面產品係我之前用過最好嘅！塗落皮膚感覺超級超級柔軟，清潔效果好好！用完之後皮膚感覺好乾淨！我絕對推薦！不過我覺得乾性皮膚用嘅話，可能會乾得過份少少！

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Low Molecule Hyaluronic Acid Cleansing Foam 150mL Special Set (+30mL)
reviews.text: Ok honestly really love this but the packaging MOLDS! I tried it twice to make sure it’s not just one time but it happens each time. The plastic around the edge start smelling so bad. Such a shame because it cleanses well and is very moisturizing but I just can’t get over the packaging being prone to molding.
reviews.zh: OK，老實講我真係好鍾意，但係包裝會發霉！我試咗兩次，確保唔係一次性嘅問題，但每次都會發生。膠樽邊緣開始有好難聞嘅味道。好可惜，因為佢清潔效果好，保濕都好，但係我實在過唔到包裝容易發霉嘅問題。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Low Molecule Hyaluronic Acid Cleansing Foam 150mL Special Set (+30mL)
reviews.text: If you are a person who likes to see bubbles when you emulsify the product, this definitely has bubbles. Gentle yet skin feels clean and prepared for next steps in your skin routine. I also have used as a hand wash in my hands as I am over 50 and try to use gentle cleansers on my hands.
reviews.zh: 如果你鍾意搓產品時見到泡沫，呢款絕對有好多泡沫。溫和但係皮膚感覺清潔，為護膚程序嘅下一步做好準備。我已經超過 50 歲，所以我都有用佢嚟洗手，因為我會盡量用溫和嘅潔面產品洗手。

reviews.text: It's my everyday cleanser. I have extremely dry skin, and recently I had a skin inflammation. My skin was very sensitive, making washing my face painful and difficult. I tried other products claiming to be gentle, they all were irritating, but only this cleanser was gentle and non irritating for me. This cleanser has a smooth, creamy texture and lathers well.
reviews.zh: 佢係我日常嘅潔面產品。我嘅皮膚非常乾燥，而且最近皮膚發炎。我嘅皮膚好敏感，洗面都痛、好辛苦。我試過其他聲稱溫和嘅產品，全部都會刺激，但係只有呢款潔面產品對我嚟講係溫和、冇刺激。呢款質地順滑、似奶霜，起泡都好。

reviews.text: I am in love with this cleanser! It is gentle and not drying, and it thoroughly cleanses. It’s gentle enough to be used in the morning, and still does a really good job taking off makeup at night. There were two cleansers in this value pack and it will last me a while. I would definitely repurchase!
reviews.zh: 我超級愛呢款潔面產品！佢溫和唔會乾燥，清潔得好徹底。夠溫和，早上都可以用，而且晚上卸妝都做得好好。今次套裝入面有兩支潔面產品，可以用好耐。我絕對會再買！

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Cleansing Foam 150mL
reviews.text: A foaming cleanser that’s better recommended for oily skin. It has a rich creamy lather, although may feel stripping at times. A small amount goes a long way, doesn’t sting nor irritate my skin. Not really hydrating as it’s marketed but still does the job of cleansing.
reviews.zh: 一款起泡潔面產品，比較適合油性皮膚。佢起泡好豐富、似奶霜咁，不過有時可能會覺得偏脫脂。只需要少少份量就夠，唔會刺痛，亦都唔會刺激我嘅皮膚。唔似宣傳咁真係好保濕，不過清潔效果都做到。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
